purpose: Teach: 丞/濱/荒野/北西/南海/会津/準々/ペニス

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、医療古文書の丞、つまり「丞」職の医薬記録を医療チームで保管します
lines.en: Ren, we'll be maintaining medical records from historical documents — the 'jou' position records — as a team.
lines.style: Clear, professional tone. Measured pace with slight emphasis on key responsibilities. Steady eye contact, matter-of-fact delivery without rushed urgency.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、旧字「濱」、つまり浜地域の医療連携を医療チームで進めます
lines.en: Ren, we're going to coordinate medical services across the Hama region — using the older characters — as a unified team.
lines.style: Same professional register. Slight pause before the regional name to allow it to register. Clinical precision but not cold. Methodical.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、荒野、つまり僻地の医療を医療チームで担当します
lines.en: Ren, we'll be taking on medical care in rural and remote areas as part of the team effort.
lines.style: Steady, assured tone. Emphasizes the reach and importance of rural coverage without dramatizing it. Consistent pace.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、北西気象、つまり北西強風時の搬送計画を医療チームで整えます
lines.en: Ren, we're establishing transport protocols for strong northwestern winds — we'll coordinate that as a team.
lines.style: Slightly more deliberate. Acknowledges the practical concern of weather conditions. Professional but not detached. Careful enunciation.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、南海地震時の医療救護を医療チームで連携します
lines.en: Ren, we'll be coordinating emergency medical response for seismic events in the Nankai region as a team.
lines.style: Steady and clear. The gravity of earthquake preparedness comes through without inflection change — delivered as routine excellence. Composed.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、会津地方の医師会と医療チームで連携します
lines.en: Ren, we're partnering with the Aizu Medical Association — collaborative effort with the team.
lines.style: Even, professional. Slight warmth on 'partnership' — recognition that collaboration requires the team's engagement, not just coordination.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、医学会の準々決勝、つまり中間選考の発表を医療チームで担当します
lines.en: Ren, we'll be presenting at the medical conference semifinals — the mid-round selection — as a team.
lines.style: Precise and measured. Light emphasis on the competitive/selective nature without tension. Clinical clarity on the stage of competition.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、ペニスに関する泌尿器科の手術を医療チームで担当します
lines.en: Ren, we're handling the urology surgical cases as a coordinated team.
lines.style: Professional matter-of-factness. No hesitation or euphemism — clinical register. Steady delivery. Closes with quiet finality and acknowledgment of the weight.
